def solve(data):
    packages = data['packages']
    roots = data['roots']
    names = sorted(packages)

    best = None
    best_vector = None

    def search(versions, pending):
        nonlocal best, best_vector
        pending = pending - versions.keys()
        if not pending:
            vector = tuple(versions.get(name, -1) for name in names)
            if best_vector is None or vector > best_vector:
                best = dict(versions)
                best_vector = vector
            return

        name = min(pending)
        if name not in packages:
            return
        bounds = roots.get(name)
        rows = packages[name]
        for row in rows:
            version = row['version']
            if bounds is not None and not (bounds[0] <= version <= bounds[1]):
                continue
            deps = row.get('deps', [])
            if isinstance(deps, str):
                deps = [deps]
            search(
                {**versions, name: version},
                (pending - {name}) | set(deps),
            )

    search({}, set(roots))
    return {'versions': best if best is not None else {}}
